parameters.query:
-- Vagas novas que ainda não foram avaliadas
SELECT j.id, j.source, j.title, j.company, j.location, j.remote,
       j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.url, j.description
  FROM jobs j
  LEFT JOIN match_results m ON m.job_id = j.id
 WHERE m.job_id IS NULL
   AND j.discovered_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
 ORDER BY j.discovered_at DESC
 LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO match_results (job_id, score, requirements_met, requirements_gap, summary, llm_model, llm_cost_usd)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4::jsonb,$5,$6,$7)
ON CONFLICT (job_id) DO UPDATE SET
  score = EXCLUDED.score,
  requirements_met = EXCLUDED.requirements_met,
  requirements_gap = EXCLUDED.requirements_gap,
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  llm_model = EXCLUDED.llm_model,
  llm_cost_usd = EXCLUDED.llm_cost_usd,
  evaluated_at = now();
